PASS — commit 4381632. Realized P&L on moving weighted-average cost: a SELL releases qty x avg_cost taken before the quantity drops. Not FIFO, and the reason matters — the open side has folded on average cost since bd:shotockviz-msg, so FIFO on the realized side would put two halves of one book on two cost flows and realized+unrealized would stop reconciling; and transactions.date is a DATE with no lot id, so a FIFO answer would depend on whatever row order Postgres returned for same-day trades. Two grains reported because they are different numbers: RealizedSale per SELL (ledger truth) and ClosedTrade per round trip (what a trader reads). Win/loss judged in THB because a USD gain can be a THB loss. profit_factor is None with no losses — undefined, not infinite. Explicitly not tax output; the endpoint says so.
